(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A system for generating a counter-stimulation in a patient suffering from RLS, the system comprising: a device configured and arranged to generate a counter-stimulation in a patient suffering from RLS, the counter-stimulation of an amplitude, intensity, and time duration either lower than that which would wake the patient and higher than that sufficient to relieve RLS symptoms, or sufficient to relieve RLS symptoms and allow the patient to return to sleep; a controller configured and arranged to drive the counter-stimulation generation device, the controller in communication with the counter-stimulation generation device; and a base configured and arranged to hold the counter-stimulation generation device adjacent to a patient, the counter-stimulation generation device attached to the base in a manner insufficient to directly apply pressure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The system according to Claim 1, wherein the device comprises a stimulator selected from the group consisting of a fluid pressure applicator, a mechanical point pressure applicator, a mechanical roller, a mechanical lift, a vibration generator, a nerve stimulator, a muscle stimulator, a heater, a cooler, a chemical applicator, and a magnet, excluding solely the fluid pressure applicator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A method of treating RLS, the method comprising: selecting a patient experiencing RLS; stimulating a portion of the patient at an amplitude, intensity, and duration sufficient to act as a counter-stimulation to RLS and either to allow the patient to return to sleep or to not wake a sleeping patient, wherein the stimulation is provided via vibration therapy in conjunction with a fluid pressure application device, the stimulation selected to avoid directly waking the patient.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method according to Claim 15, wherein said counter-stimulation is selected from the group consisting of pressure application, mechanical point pressure application, vibration, a nerve stimulation, a muscle stimulation, heat, cold, a chemical application, and magnetism, excluding exclusively a fluid pressure application.
